svg.title: Fuse preparation while leaving FA3 attention and required rounding intact

text.tspan: Remove intermediate launches; keep the same consumer.
QK norm + RoPE + FP8 KV store
BF16 query leaves the kernel; its cast still runs.
QK norm + RoPE + FP8 KV store + FP8 Q
BF16 rounding still happens inside the fused kernel.
Schematic launch sequence: widths do not represent duration.
